statement.zh: **标准**：平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）（Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines (SP 800-193)）。摘要自述对象与性质：「This document provides technical guidelines and recommendations supporting resiliency of platform firmware and data against potentially destructive attacks.」并定义平台：「The platform is a collection of fundamental hardware and firmware components needed to boot and operate a system.」三原则在摘要中一句写尽：「The technical guidelines in this document promote resiliency in the platform by describing security mechanisms for protecting the platform against unauthorized changes, detecting unauthorized changes that occur, and recovering from attacks rapidly and securely.
statement.en: **Standard**: Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines (SP 800-193) (平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）).The abstract states the object and the character of the document: "This document provides technical guidelines and recommendations supporting resiliency of platform firmware and data against potentially destructive attacks." and defines its subject: "The platform is a collection of fundamental hardware and firmware components needed to boot and operate a system.

statement.zh: 风险写在摘要：「A successful attack on platform firmware could render a system inoperable, perhaps permanently, or requiring reprogramming by the original manufacturer, resulting in significant disruptions to users.」执行摘要说明为何难修：「Much of this firmware is highly privileged in the system architectures, and because this firmware is necessary for the system to operate, repairing this firmware can be challenging.」要补的缺口是既有指南只覆盖一类固件：「Earlier NIST publications have addressed the threat of attacks on one particular type of platform firmware: boot firmware, commonly known as the Basic Input/Output System (BIOS).」紧接着补上范围：「However, the platform consists of many other devices with firmware and configuration data.
statement.en: The risk is in the abstract: "A successful attack on platform firmware could render a system inoperable, perhaps permanently, or requiring reprogramming by the original manufacturer, resulting in significant disruptions to users." The executive summary says why repair is hard: "Much of this firmware is highly privileged in the system architectures, and because this firmware is necessary for the system to operate, repairing this firmware can be challenging." The gap in existing guidance is named next: "Earlier NIST publications have addressed the threat of attacks on one particular type of platform firmware: boot firmware, commonly known as the Basic Input/Output System (BIOS).

statement.zh: 平台固件韧性指南（SP 800-193）的used见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: Readers and duties are set out in layers.The abstract splits them: "Implementers, including Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and component/device suppliers, can use these guidelines to build stronger security mechanisms into platforms." and "System administrators, security professionals, and users can use this document to guide procurement strategies and priorities for future systems." Section 1.1 restates the aim: "The purpose of this document is to provide security guidelines to support system resiliency at a platform level.

statement.zh: 它是指南而非强制。Authority 段自陈不改变既有权威：「Nor should these guidelines be interpreted as altering or superseding the existing authorities of the Secretary of Commerce, Director of the OMB, or any other federal official.」并写明联邦体系外的用法：「This publication may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States.」§1.3 收窄威胁面：「The goal of this document is to provide principles and guidelines that can support platform resiliency primarily against remote attacks.」§1.4 记下一部分只是背景材料：「Section 2 provides informative material describing platform components and architectures.
statement.en: It is guidance, not a mandate.The Authority block says the guidelines change no existing authority: "Nor should these guidelines be interpreted as altering or superseding the existing authorities of the Secretary of Commerce, Director of the OMB, or any other federal official." and puts use outside federal systems on a voluntary footing: "This publication may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States." Section 1.3 narrows the threat set: "The goal of this document is to provide principles and guidelines that can support platform resiliency primarily against remote attacks." Section 1.

statement.zh: 扉页首行是「NIST Special Publication 800-193」，作者与部门所在行连读为「Andrew Regenscheid Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory」，免费获取行写「This publication is available free of charge from:」，DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-193。Authority 段的引用行给出日期与页数：「Natl.Inst.Stand.Technol.Spec.Publ.800-193, 45 pages (May 2018)」，即 2018 年 5 月版；本文件未在门面板块声明取代任何出版物。致谢页把作者与评审者写在一起：「The author, Andrew Regenscheid of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), wishes to thank his colleagues who reviewed drafts of this document and contributed to its technical content.」并列出业界与政府专家：「These experts included Chirag Schroff from Cisco; Mukund Khatri from Dell;」。
statement.en: The first title-block line reads "NIST Special Publication 800-193", the author and division line reads as one sequence "Andrew Regenscheid Computer Security Division Information Technology Laboratory", and the free-access line reads "This publication is available free of charge from:" followed by the DOI 10.6028/NIST.SP.800-193.The citation in the Authority block carries the date and length: "Natl.
